meta.name: calibrate-claim-confidence
meta.description: When the agent's epistemic state (GCCRF) indicates low empowerment and falling certainty, hedges out confident absolutes ("definitely", "always", "100%") in outgoing messages.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 自动弱化消息中的绝对化表述
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在沟通中减少绝对化语气，提升表达弹性。
copy.tagline_en: Automatically soften absolute statements in messages
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to reduce absolute language in communication for more nuanced expression.

howto.what: 当 Claude 不确定时，它会自动把“肯定”“总是”“100%”等绝对词改成“可能”“通常”“看起来”等更委婉的说法。
howto.when: 当 Claude 的内部状态显示它掌握的信息不足（empowerment < 0.3）且确定性在下降时，在它发送消息前触发。

say.text: 这个方案肯定能解决所有问题。
say.note: Claude 会改成“可能能解决”等更谨慎的说法。

say.text: 用户总是会喜欢这个设计。
say.note: Claude 会改成“通常”或“往往”。

howto.what_en: When Claude is uncertain, it automatically rewrites confident absolutes like "definitely", "always", "100%" into hedged language such as "likely", "typically", "it appears".
howto.when_en: Triggers before sending a message when Claude's internal state shows low empowerment (< 0.3) and falling certainty.

say_en.text: This plan will definitely solve all problems.
say_en.note: Claude will hedge to "likely" or similar.
